criterion.criterion_summary: Move internal replay functional callers to the canonical Scientist owner while preserving the exact 20-symbol runtime/replay.py compatibility surface and ten lazy Runtime-root exports until the supported window and external-caller scope are resolved. Preserve object identity, signatures, enum values, and lazy import behavior; keep dynamic-import inventory and justified delayed CLI load coherent. Do not invent an issuer, retirement date, or zero external usage. Whole acceptance includes real CLI/check-only, retained supported CAS bundle import/export/replay/resume with byte and identity preservation, a fresh schema-valid Foundry execution/readback, wheel import smoke, import-budget and reflective/FQN/monkeypatch consumer checks; removal timing is a separate G/API lifecycle decision.
